title: Where the payment objects sit in HTTP, MCP and A2A
caption: The same three objects (PaymentRequired, PaymentPayload, SettleResponse) ride in headers over HTTP, in an MCP tool result and the _meta field of the retried tool call, and in task metadata over A2A. The facilitator API underneath is standardized as HTTP.
alt: Three columns. HTTP: 402 with the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, then the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, then the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. MCP: a tool result with isError true and PaymentRequired in structuredContent, then the _meta key x402/payment, then the _meta key x402/payment-response. A2A: a task in input-required with metadata x402.payment.required, then message metadata x402.payment.payload, then metadata x402.payment.receipts. All three lead to the facilitator API, which is standardized as HTTP.
